method: Unity PlayMode on isolated flat technical ground; original controller active, autorun, no jump, normal gravity. GaitPhase also drives existing controller footsteps. Samples captures at 30 fps, simulationHz reported separately; clip length and ruler spacing chosen so the looping GIF restarts on the same pose phase and ground pattern. Sprite painting kept intact; contact uses visual-only root motion. No production scene change or platform-art validation.
limitation: A drawn contact-pose foot anchor is recorded in every sample: inspect world-X drift during the same stance, not just vertical coincidence. GIF has no audio. Device CPU/GPU and final platform contacts are not validated.
